decisions.reason: For n=1, r>0 and finite s>0, g(I,theta)=I exp(-theta^2) is entire and |g|<=r exp(s^2) on B_r x S_s, yet for I nonzero its values at theta=0 and 2pi differ. The original H_{r,s} membership conditions therefore admit data that do not descend to the angular torus. Periodicity only for functions of theta alone does not constrain this datum. The same omission affects H_{r,s,h} and general Hamiltonian data. Repaired by explicitly requiring g(I,theta+2pi k,nu)=g(I,theta,nu) at every domain point (with absent variables omitted), and by requiring the same periodicity for Hamiltonian data.
